annotations.title: Technical datasheet of a Siemens product

description: Returns the technical datasheet of one Siemens industry product by its article number (MLFB, for example "6EP3436-8SB00-0AY0") as structured data: sections of properties with values and units (supply voltage, currents, power loss, dimensions, ambient conditions, ...), eClass and ETIM classes and certificates. Use it to check ratings, compare products or verify that devices fit together, for example summing the 24 V DC current of controllers against a power supply rating. When the user only names a product family or a rating, find the article number first with siemens_search and scope "articles". Some product families publish their data only as PDF: then "hasTechnicalData" is false; give the user "datasheetPdfUrl" and do not guess values. Do not use it for prices, availability or delivery times, which it does not return, or for non-Siemens products.

articleNumber.description: Siemens article number (MLFB) exactly as in the catalog, for example "6ES7214-1AG40-0XB0" or "3RV2021-4EA10". Case and extra spaces do not matter.

language.description: Datasheet language: en (default), de, fr, es, it or zh. Property names and text values are translated; numbers and units stay the same.

section.description: Only return sections whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), for example "supply voltage" or "ambient". Omit for the full datasheet; "availableSections" lists all names.

name: siemens_product_datasheet

availableSections.description: All section names of the datasheet, also when filtered.

system.description: eClass, ETIM, IDEA or another scheme.

hasTechnicalData.description: false when the HTML datasheet carries no technical data table; then only the PDF datasheet may have it.

lastModified.description: Date the datasheet data was last changed, as printed.

number.description: Numeric part, only for a plain "number unit" value.

path.description: Sub-headings above the property inside its section.

value.description: Value as printed, including the unit.
